facts.claim: Berlin Dungeon announces its final day on 6 November 2026 and permanent closure from 7 November.
facts.excerpt: fter more than 13 years of bringing Berlin’s darker history to life, we regret to announce that the Berlin Dungeon will permanently close from 7 November 2026. Its final day of operation will be 6 November 2026. For over a decade, guests have journeyed through some of Berlin’s most infamous stories, becoming part of the action through our live actors, special effects and storytelling. A huge thank you goes to our team, who have brought so many chillingly memorable moments to life, and to every guest who has visited us over the years. Make the most of the remaining weeks. We remain open until 6 November and look forward to welcoming guests for one final visit. Book your tickets now. If you have already booked tickets beyond 6 November, you will receive direct communication from us in the coming days outlining your options.
